team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 passive: After switching, +48% ATK to the on field party member for 10s
R5 passive: After switching, +24% ATK in average

en.flavor: A fictional story of a band of five heroes who go off on a dragon hunt. It is poorly written and structurally incoherent. Its value lies in the many lessons that can be learned from failure.

refinements.1: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by <r>24%</r> for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.
refinements.2: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by <r>30%</r> for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.
refinements.3: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by <r>36%</r> for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.
refinements.4: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by <r>42%</r> for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.
refinements.5: When switching characters, the new character taking the field has their ATK increased by <r>48%</r> for 10s. This effect can only occur once every 20s.

fr.flavor: L'histoire de cinq héros partant à la chasse au dragon. L'ouvrage est mal écrit et particulièrement incohérent. Sa valeur réside dans les nombreuses leçons que l'on peut tirer de l'échec.
